# Lower-third name title

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/lower-third`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (basic). A designed lower-third sits in the bottom 30 % of the frame, left-aligned inside the safe margin, with a bold name line and a smaller role line on a subtle bar, slides in over about 0.4 s, stays 4 to 6 s and fades out.

## Details

### When to use
Introducing a speaker, place or topic.
### What a pro does and why
Keep to two lines and one accent colour.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Lower-third: name and role",
  "reason": "You asked for a name and role on screen: a lower-third title at the start of the clip",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "add_title", "template": "lowerThird", "lines": ["Alex Morgan", "Producer"], "start": 2, "duration": 5, "style": {"fontFamily": "Montserrat", "fillColor": "#FFFFFF", "backgroundColor": "#111111", "backgroundOpacity": 0.6}, "animateIn": "slideLeft", "animateOut": "fade"}
  ]
}
```
### How to adjust
More branded: an accent `backgroundColor`. Calmer: `animateIn` "fade". Too small: `fontSizePx` 56 in style. Lower: the template already keeps a safe margin; say so if the user asks to go to the very edge.
